title: RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views
title_zh: RepoAtlas：通过动态演化的多模态仓库视图引导编程智能体
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-powered coding agents have made rapid progress in automating software engineering tasks, yet repository-level issue resolution remains challenging. Beyond generating a plausible patch, an agent must localize relevant code across interdependent files and maintain repository context that is both sufficient and focused. Code graphs expose non-local relations, but linear text interfaces obscure their topology; rendering the full repository graph yields visual representations that are too dense to perceive reliably, whereas a one-shot local view becomes stale as exploration proceeds. We present \textbf{RepoAtlas}, a training-free module that maintains evolving multimodal repository views through a \emph{select--project--refresh} loop over a repository code graph. RepoAtlas combines evidence from the issue with the agent's current exploration state to select a task-relevant region under a fixed budget, projects the selected structure into complementary visual and textual representations, and refreshes the view when changes in the exploration state render it outdated. We evaluate RepoAtlas on SWE-bench Verified, where it improves the resolve rate by 2.4 points while reducing input tokens and model calls by 5.8\% and 7.8\% on average, relative to the strongest multimodal graph baseline, with consistent gains across three models of different families and scales.
abstract_zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编程智能体在自动化软件工程任务上进展迅速，但解决仓库级问题仍然充满挑战。智能体不仅要生成合理的补丁，还必须跨相互依赖的文件定位相关代码，并维护既充分又聚焦的仓库上下文。代码图能够揭示非局部关系，但线性文本界面会掩盖其拓扑结构；完整仓库图的可视化过于密集，难以可靠理解，而一次性生成的局部视图又会随着探索推进而过时。本文提出 RepoAtlas，一个无需训练的模块，通过在仓库代码图上执行“选择—投影—刷新”（select–project–refresh）循环，维护动态演化的多模态仓库视图。RepoAtlas 综合问题描述与智能体当前探索状态，在固定预算内选择与任务相关的代码区域，将所选结构投影为互补的视觉和文本表示，并在探索状态变化导致视图过时时进行刷新。在 SWE-bench Verified 上，相较于最强的多模态图基线，RepoAtlas 将问题解决率提高了 2.4 个百分点，同时平均减少 5.8% 的输入 token 和 7.8% 的模型调用；这一改进在三个不同模型家族与规模的模型上均保持一致。
key_points_zh: 提出无需训练的 RepoAtlas，为编程智能体维护随探索过程动态更新的多模态仓库视图。
采用“选择—投影—刷新”循环，结合 issue 信息与当前探索状态，在固定预算内筛选任务相关代码区域。
将代码图结构同时投影为互补的视觉表示与文本表示，兼顾拓扑关系感知和语言模型处理能力。
当智能体探索状态发生变化、现有视图过时时自动刷新，避免一次性局部视图失效。
在 SWE-bench Verified 上，解决率提升 2.4 个百分点，输入 token 和模型调用分别平均减少 5.8% 与 7.8%。

llm_assessment.comment: RepoAtlas contributes a reusable closed-loop repository-context module that improves coding-agent localization while reducing inference costs.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: RepoAtlas提供了可复用的闭环代码库上下文模块，在降低推理成本的同时提升编码智能体的定位能力。
